newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-BHP buys coal mine from RTZ-CRA.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-BHP buys coal mine from RTZ-CRA.

text.p: The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd said on Wednesday it had bought an Australian coal mine from Kembla Coke and Coal, a unit of RTZ Plc-CRA Ltd.

"The purchase of West Cliff will enable BHP Collieries to achieve cost Improvement in washing, transport and handling of coal through synergies with our adjacent Appin mine," said BHP Collieries Division Group General Manager, Col Weatherstone.

"The acquisition further provides a platform for possible future growth within our operations," Weatherstone said in a statement. BHP did not comment on the price of the purchase of the West Cliff mine, located in New South Wales.
Weatherstone said the West Cliff mine acquisition also provides more cost effective access and the ability to increase output from adjacent BHP reserves.
At 10.15 a.m. (2315 GMT), both BHP and CRA shares were steady at A$17.00 and A$18.30 respectively.
